rows.text: Incluso sobre pavimento seco se aplican ambos frenos progresivamente: juntos pueden reducir la distancia de detención frente al uso de uno solo.
evidence: Oregon DMV, Motorcycle and Moped Manual, Stopping: usare correttamente entrambi i freni riduce lo spazio di arresto; https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_motorcycle_moped_manual/section_4.aspx

rows.text: No se usa solo el delantero: incluso en pavimento seco se accionan ambos frenos para reducir la velocidad eficazmente.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_Motorcycle_Moped_Manual/Section_4.aspx — Stopping: usare entrambi i freni con gradualità, evitando il bloccaggio; Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi.

rows.text: Usar un solo freno no es la técnica habitual: aplicar juntos y progresivamente el delantero y el trasero puede reducir la distancia de detención.
evidence: Oregon DMV, Motorcycle and Moped Manual, Stopping: uso progressivo di entrambi i freni e riduzione dello spazio di arresto; https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_motorcycle_moped_manual/section_4.aspx

rows.text: Usar ambos frenos aprovecha la capacidad de frenado de las dos ruedas; hay que accionarlos de forma controlada.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_Motorcycle_Moped_Manual/Section_4.aspx — Stopping: usare entrambi i freni con gradualità, evitando il bloccaggio; Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi.

rows.text: Al frenar, la carga se desplaza hacia la rueda delantera. Mover el peso del cuerpo hacia atrás contrarresta parte de ese desplazamiento, sin eliminarlo; usa ambos frenos de forma controlada y evita bloquear las ruedas.
evidence: Manuale Muoversi in sicurezza con il ciclomotore, MIUR/MIT/ANCMA, edizione aggiornata al 15 ottobre 2004, pp.16 e 18; https://sicurezzastradale.itisavogadro.org/risorse/patentino/muoversi_in_sicurezza.pdf ; copia verificabile /tmp/rotonda-muoversi-in-sicurezza.pdf SHA-256 8c8a536583942ccdbefea80a738a53dd6691b2aab945345c9c39eb6225373e81. P.18 descrive frenata e tendenza a sbandare, p.16 sequenza degli specchi.

Washington State DOL, Motorcycle Operator Manual, braking: il carico si trasferisce in avanti in frenata; https://dol.wa.gov/driver-licenses-and-permits/motorcycle/motorcycle-endorsement-training-and-testing/motorcycle-operator-manual/motorcycle-operator-manual-text-only

Inferenza meccanica qualitativa: arretrare la massa del corpo sposta all’indietro il baricentro complessivo e contrasta parte dell’aumento di carico anteriore dovuto alla decelerazione; non annulla necessariamente il trasferimento. Le fonti citate attestano separatamente il trasferimento in avanti e la raccomandazione di posizione, senza affermare testualmente questa relazione causale.

rows.text: Se frena con firmeza sin bloquear las ruedas: una presión excesiva puede hacerlas derrapar y comprometer el control.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_Motorcycle_Moped_Manual/Section_4.aspx — Stopping: usare entrambi i freni con gradualità, evitando il bloccaggio; Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi.

rows.text: No se usa solo el delantero: en una emergencia se usan ambos frenos, aplicando la presión de forma controlada.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_Motorcycle_Moped_Manual/Section_4.aspx — Stopping: usare entrambi i freni con gradualità, evitando il bloccaggio; Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi.

rows.text: El freno trasero por sí solo no aprovecha la capacidad del delantero: usar ambos de manera controlada puede reducir la distancia de detención.
evidence: Oregon DMV, Motorcycle and Moped Manual, Stopping: uso di entrambi i freni e riduzione dello spazio di arresto; https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_motorcycle_moped_manual/section_4.aspx

rows.text: No se busca bloquear las ruedas frenando a tirones: se frena con firmeza y control, evitando que derrapen.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_Motorcycle_Moped_Manual/Section_4.aspx — Stopping: usare entrambi i freni con gradualità, evitando il bloccaggio; Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi.

rows.text: Si el ciclomotor empieza a derrapar al frenar, reducir gradualmente el esfuerzo de frenado puede ayudar a recuperar adherencia y control. Las guías difieren cuando la rueda trasera ya está bloqueada; la pregunta no describe ese caso.
evidence: Manuale Muoversi in sicurezza con il ciclomotore, MIUR/MIT/ANCMA, edizione aggiornata al 15 ottobre 2004, pp.16 e 18; https://sicurezzastradale.itisavogadro.org/risorse/patentino/muoversi_in_sicurezza.pdf ; copia verificabile /tmp/rotonda-muoversi-in-sicurezza.pdf SHA-256 8c8a536583942ccdbefea80a738a53dd6691b2aab945345c9c39eb6225373e81. P.18 descrive frenata e tendenza a sbandare, p.16 sequenza degli specchi.

UK DVSA, Steering and manoeuvring, Skidding: frenata eccessiva può causare perdita di aderenza; la guida descrive una manovra di rilascio, ma le istruzioni per ruota posteriore già bloccata non sono uniformi tra manuali; https://www.safedrivingforlife.info/advice/motorcycle-riding/how-to-ride-a-motorcycle/steering-and-manoeuvring-a-motorcycle/

South Carolina DMV, Motorcycle and Moped Operator Manual, Skids: diversa indicazione per ruota posteriore già bloccata; https://dmv.sc.gov/sites/scdmv/files/2026-06/Motorcycle%20and%20Moped%20Operator%27s%20Manual.pdf

rows.text: La inestabilidad al frenar también puede deberse a frenos desiguales o defectuosos. Detente de forma segura y haz revisar el vehículo; si no es seguro, no sigas circulando y organiza su traslado al taller.
evidence: Manuale Muoversi in sicurezza con il ciclomotore, MIUR/MIT/ANCMA, edizione aggiornata al 15 ottobre 2004, pp.16 e 18; https://sicurezzastradale.itisavogadro.org/risorse/patentino/muoversi_in_sicurezza.pdf ; copia verificabile /tmp/rotonda-muoversi-in-sicurezza.pdf SHA-256 8c8a536583942ccdbefea80a738a53dd6691b2aab945345c9c39eb6225373e81. P.18 descrive frenata e tendenza a sbandare, p.16 sequenza degli specchi.

UK DVSA, Steering and manoeuvring, Skidding: freni in cattive condizioni possono agire irregolarmente e causare sbandamento; https://www.safedrivingforlife.info/advice/motorcycle-riding/how-to-ride-a-motorcycle/steering-and-manoeuvring-a-motorcycle/

rows.text: Con el vehículo detenido también se revisa la presión de los neumáticos: si es incorrecta puede afectar el frenado y la estabilidad.
evidence: https://dmv.sc.gov/sites/scdmv/files/2026-06/Motorcycle%20and%20Moped%20Operator%27s%20Manual.pdf — Appendix A, T-CLOCS: pressione scorretta altera la manovrabilità; sezione 6-3: una posteriore che slitta richiede di mantenere il freno applicato fino all’arresto. Il manuale tratta anche ciclomotori.

rows.text: Mantener la calma ayuda a evitar maniobras bruscas y controlar el frenado, en vez de reaccionar por impulso al derrape.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_Motorcycle_Moped_Manual/Section_4.aspx — Stopping: usare entrambi i freni con gradualità, evitando il bloccaggio; Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi.

rows.text: El nivel de aceite del motor es una revisión de mantenimiento, pero no es la revisión prioritaria indicada por la pregunta tras un derrape al frenar: una vez detenido, revisa los neumáticos y los frenos. Una fuga u otra falla mecánica también requiere atención.
evidence: https://sicurezzastradale.itisavogadro.org/risorse/patentino/muoversi_in_sicurezza.pdf — Muoversi in sicurezza con il ciclomotore, testo a cura MIUR, MIT e ANCMA, aggiornato 15 ottobre 2004, pp. 16, 18 e 47: sequenza degli specchi; frenata di emergenza e sbandamento; trasferimento del carico in avanti.

https://dmv.ny.gov/motorcycle-manual/motorcycle-manual-preparing-to-ride — Check Your Motorcycle: controlli distinti per pneumatici, perdite e livello olio, e freni; regolare gli specchi prima della partenza.
https://www.safedrivingforlife.info/advice/motorcycle-riding/how-to-ride-a-motorcycle/steering-and-manoeuvring-a-motorcycle/ — Skidding: anche freni difettosi possono causare sbandamento.

rows.text: Frenar a fondo y girar bruscamente puede superar la adherencia disponible y empeorar el derrape. Evita maniobras bruscas; las guías difieren para una rueda trasera ya bloqueada, situación que la pregunta no especifica.
evidence: Manuale Muoversi in sicurezza con il ciclomotore, MIUR/MIT/ANCMA, edizione aggiornata al 15 ottobre 2004, pp.16 e 18; https://sicurezzastradale.itisavogadro.org/risorse/patentino/muoversi_in_sicurezza.pdf ; copia verificabile /tmp/rotonda-muoversi-in-sicurezza.pdf SHA-256 8c8a536583942ccdbefea80a738a53dd6691b2aab945345c9c39eb6225373e81. P.18 descrive frenata e tendenza a sbandare, p.16 sequenza degli specchi.

UK DVSA, Steering and manoeuvring, Skidding: frenata intensa e sterzate possono causare perdita di aderenza; https://www.safedrivingforlife.info/advice/motorcycle-riding/how-to-ride-a-motorcycle/steering-and-manoeuvring-a-motorcycle/

South Carolina DMV, Motorcycle and Moped Operator Manual, Skids: istruzioni specifiche per ruota posteriore bloccata differiscono da altre guide; https://dmv.sc.gov/sites/scdmv/files/2026-06/Motorcycle%20and%20Moped%20Operator%27s%20Manual.pdf

rows.text: Soltar bruscamente el acelerador no corrige un derrape al frenar: evita maniobras bruscas y controla el frenado. En una frenada de emergencia, cierra el acelerador suavemente.
evidence: https://www.msi.org.za/street-braking/ — Street Braking: chiudere dolcemente il gas durante la frenata; movimenti bruschi possono destabilizzare il mezzo.

rows.text: Ajusta los espejos con el vehículo detenido, después de ponerte el casco, en posición de conducción y antes de salir. El casco puede reducir el campo visual: comprueba la vista hacia atrás en las condiciones de conducción.
evidence: https://sicurezzastradale.itisavogadro.org/risorse/patentino/muoversi_in_sicurezza.pdf — Muoversi in sicurezza con il ciclomotore, testo a cura MIUR, MIT e ANCMA, aggiornato 15 ottobre 2004, pp. 16, 18 e 47: sequenza degli specchi; frenata di emergenza e sbandamento; trasferimento del carico in avanti.

https://saaq.gouv.qc.ca/blob/saaq/documents/publications/operating-motorcycle.pdf — pp. 92–93, visual checks e adjusting rear-view mirrors: il casco può ridurre il campo visivo; specchi regolati per la vista posteriore. Verificare la vista col casco è una conseguenza pratica, non un beneficio specifico dichiarato dalla fonte.

https://dmv.ny.gov/motorcycle-manual/motorcycle-manual-preparing-to-ride — Check Your Motorcycle: controlli distinti per pneumatici, perdite e livello olio, e freni; regolare gli specchi prima della partenza.

rows.text: Se ajustan con el vehículo detenido y derecho, con el soporte levantado y en la posición de conducción: así la vista corresponde a la de la marcha.
evidence: https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_Motorcycle_Moped_Manual/Section_4.aspx — Stopping: usare entrambi i freni con gradualità, evitando il bloccaggio; Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi.

rows.text: Los espejos se ajustan antes de salir para observar el tráfico de atrás desde el principio, sin intentar ajustarlos en movimiento.
evidence: https://dmv.ny.gov/motorcycle-manual/motorcycle-manual-preparing-to-ride — Check Your Motorcycle: controlli separati per pressione pneumatici, olio e freni; specchi regolati prima di partire.

rows.text: Ajustar los espejos desde la posición de conducción ayuda a ver correctamente detrás. El cuestionario indica hacerlo antes de salir y después de recoger el soporte; el orden puede depender del tipo de soporte.
evidence: Manuale Muoversi in sicurezza con il ciclomotore, MIUR/MIT/ANCMA, edizione aggiornata al 15 ottobre 2004, pp.16 e 18; https://sicurezzastradale.itisavogadro.org/risorse/patentino/muoversi_in_sicurezza.pdf ; copia verificabile /tmp/rotonda-muoversi-in-sicurezza.pdf SHA-256 8c8a536583942ccdbefea80a738a53dd6691b2aab945345c9c39eb6225373e81. P.18 descrive frenata e tendenza a sbandare, p.16 sequenza degli specchi.
Singapore Police Force, Riding Theory Booklet, Mirrors: regolare seduti sul motociclo per vedere agevolmente dietro; https://www.police.gov.sg/-/media/Spf/Advisories/RTTEN24.ashx
Oregon DMV, Mounting: sedersi, raddrizzare il mezzo, sollevare il cavalletto laterale e regolare gli specchi; https://www.oregon.gov/odot/dmv/pages/online_motorcycle_moped_manual/section_4.aspx

rows.text: No se espera a haber recorrido un tramo: se ajustan los espejos antes de salir para disponer de visión trasera desde el comienzo.
evidence: https://dmv.ny.gov/motorcycle-manual/motorcycle-manual-preparing-to-ride — Check Your Motorcycle: controlli separati per pressione pneumatici, olio e freni; specchi regolati prima di partire.

rows.text: Revisar los mandos antes de salir permite detectar si los frenos no funcionan bien antes de necesitarlos en el tráfico.
evidence: https://dmv.ny.gov/motorcycle-manual/motorcycle-manual-preparing-to-ride — Check Your Motorcycle: controlli separati per pressione pneumatici, olio e freni; specchi regolati prima di partire.

rows.text: Un dispositivo antirrobo activado puede impedir el movimiento o la maniobra: hay que desactivarlo o retirarlo antes de salir.
evidence: https://www.met.police.uk/cp/crime-prevention/keeping-vehicles-safe/theft-motorcycles-scooters/ — i bloccadisco, i blocchi ai comandi e il bloccasterzo impediscono rispettivamente il movimento del disco, dei comandi o dello sterzo.

rows.text: La dirección debe girar libremente para poder maniobrar: cualquier impedimento debe resolverse antes de salir.
evidence: https://msf-usa.org/documents/library/t-clocs-pre-ride-inspection-checklist/ — Steering-Head Bearings: controllare che lo sterzo non presenti punti duri lungo la corsa.

rows.text: Ajustar los espejos antes de salir permite ver hacia atrás desde el comienzo sin tener que acomodarlos durante la marcha.
evidence: https://dmv.ny.gov/motorcycle-manual/motorcycle-manual-preparing-to-ride — Check Your Motorcycle: controlli separati per pressione pneumatici, olio e freni; specchi regolati prima di partire.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1ea2a-4434-7c52-b833-6e99849db679
issues: 27022: The cited Italian moped manual could not be accessed to verify the claimed recommendation to move body weight back; Ohio confirms forward load transfer only. The explanation also does not explain how moving back helps. Supply accessible authoritative teaching evidence and the decisive reason while preserving the printed VERO.

27027: The unconditional instruction to reduce the brake on any skidding wheel and reapply it conflicts with Ohio Motorcycle Operator Manual, Maximum Braking and Swerving, skid recovery (https://motorcycle.ohio.gov/rider-safety-resources/motorcycle-operator-manual/maximum-braking-and-swerving): for a locked rear wheel with wheels out of alignment it advises maintaining pressure until aligned or stopped. NSW gives different advice. Resolve the discrepancy and qualify the instruction for the applicable situation instead of presenting a universal procedure.

27028: The cited Italian manual was inaccessible; the DVSA page supports defective brakes as a possible cause but does not establish that a workshop adjustment is warranted after every skid. Support or qualify the recommendation in the explanation.
27030: The only cited source, the Italian manual, was inaccessible, so its claimed support for the specific controlled response could not be checked; provide accessible authoritative evidence.

27031: The explanation says checking engine oil is not the first response, but does not explain why oil level is unrelated to diagnosing a braking skid, leaving the printed FALSO insufficiently corrected; the question is not limited to an immediate first response. Explain the distinction against a supported source.

27033: The DVSA reference says to ease off the throttle for an acceleration-induced skid, not a braking skid; its cited support is misapplied to the universal prohibition on abrupt throttle release during braking skids. The other cited manual was inaccessible. Supply situation-specific authoritative support and clarify the correction.

27034: The cited Italian manual was inaccessible, and the Oregon reference does not establish that mirrors should be adjusted after putting on a helmet. Provide accessible supporting evidence and explain why that order matters.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1ea31-b6ed-76b3-85af-a3f75df89008
issues: 27022: The claimed reason that shifting weight rearward counteracts the rider moving toward the handlebars and maintains riding position is not supported by either cited source. Ohio explains forward load transfer, not this benefit; the ministry URL returns 404. Provide authoritative support for the specific explanation or revise it without inventing a rationale.

27027, 27032: Safety-critical rear-wheel skid instructions need adjudication for the AM moped context: the cited Ohio motorcycle guide advises maintaining a misaligned locked rear brake until alignment or stopping, whereas the cited NSW handbook advises gently releasing a skidding rear brake and the South Carolina motorcycle/moped manual advises holding it until stopped. The drafts present one disputed technique in learner text without resolving applicability; also naming the Ohio guide there is a citation in learner text. Resolve with authoritative, applicable guidance and retain citations in evidence.

27028: The instruction to proceed cautiously when a defect is found or suspected is unconditional as to defect severity. The cited DVSA source supports faulty brakes as a possible cause of skidding, but does not support riding a potentially unsafe moped to a workshop. Specify a safe course depending on the defect and cite it.

27031: The categorical claim that engine oil level is not part of investigating causes of a braking skid is not established by a list of separate pre-ride checks or by the source on defective brakes. Qualify the distinction and support it without ruling out a mechanical fault.

27034: The cited New York manual supports adjusting mirrors before riding, but does not establish that wearing a helmet before adjustment gives the stated benefit. The cited ministry URL returns 404 and is not technical support. Supply an authoritative source for the helmet-specific reasoning.

27037: Oregon describes raising the side stand and then adjusting mirrors as a mounting sequence; it does not establish an obligatory order for every moped or stand type. The draft calls this a prescribed adjustment without qualification. Explain the quiz convention and cite evidence adequate for the scope.

27022, 27027–27034: The cited historical ministry PDF URL returned 404 during review, so its stated content could not be independently verified. Replace it with an accessible exact source or remove the citation where redundant.

issues: 27018, 27020, 27025: The explanation is circular: using only one brake does not use both, but this does not explain why using both matters. Oregon Stopping says combined braking shortens stopping distance; give the relevant reason rather than merely restating the technique.

27022: The explanation reports the quiz recommendation to move body weight back but does not explain why that action is recommended. The cited Italian manual PDF could not be accessed for independent verification of that posture claim; the printed quiz verdict alone is not evidence. Supply accessible authoritative support and a supported reason without changing the verdict.

27027: The text restates the quiz instruction and discusses a separate rear-wheel-lock disagreement but does not explain why reducing braking effort helps the stated tendency to skid. Explain the traction/control distinction with appropriate support and preserve the qualification about an already locked rear wheel.

27028: The text gives a cautious procedure but does not explain why a braking instability warrants a workshop check. The cited DVSA guidance identifies poor or uneven brakes as a possible cause; connect the check to a possible defect without assuming one exists.

27032: The text attributes avoiding sudden maneuvers to the quiz, although this question asserts rapid steering and is false. It repeats the proposed correction without explaining why hard braking and sharp steering can worsen loss of control. Support the explanation independently rather than treating a false assertion as authority.

27037: The text states the quiz sequence but does not explain why mirrors should be set from the actual riding position. The cited Singapore PDF and Italian PDF could not be independently accessed. Provide an accessible source and the decisive reason, while retaining the caveat about different stands.

issues: 27022: The cited Italian manual recommends shifting weight rearward and explains forward load transfer; Oregon states that good posture, including keeping knees against the tank, limits forward movement. Neither cited source says the act of moving weight back itself maintains a stable seat position. Support that specific causal claim with an exact source or revise to the sourced load-transfer and controlled-braking facts without asserting an unverified benefit.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / collaboration /root/terra_author
issues: 27022: The revised text names the moped manual in learner-facing copy, contrary to the prompt requiring citations and source metadata in evidence only. It also juxtaposes forward load transfer and the rearward-weight recommendation without explaining their relationship; this remains a restatement of the recommendation. Find an authoritative source for the mechanical relationship or precisely label a limited inference in evidence and use the resulting supported reason in learner text. Do not assert that the shift eliminates load transfer, guarantees stability, or applies identically to every braking system.
